thread:
anya: Quick design check  new idea: show a faint sparkline overlay on top of the heatmap that updates as sampling changes. would help users see micro-patterns without flipping modes.
sam: hmm ok but worried about visual clutter. sparkline + heatmap might compete. maybe a toggle that fades the heatmap to 40% opacity when sparkline is active.
tess: love the idea for power users. for casuals keep it off by default. Add a small handle in the legend to toggle sparkline. :sparkles:
rachel: UX concern: when bins change (adaptive binning) the sparkline alignment could get misleading. need visual boundary markers that align sparkline x positions to heatmap buckets.
leo: accessibility nit: animated sparkline needs `prefers-reduced-motion` support. Also ensure color choices meet contrast when overlayed. If we fade the heatmap, contrast might drop below AA.
aria: SR behavior: if sparkline toggles, announce "Sparkline overlay enabled" via `aria-live="polite"`. For bucket boundary markers, expose them in a single summary control instead of 20+ separate announcements.
katie: copy suggestion: legend toggle label: "Sparkline overlay" and tooltip: "Overlay a compact latency line on top of the heatmap". Keep tooltip short.
sam: presets convo: can we add sticky time-range presets that persist per-user? example: "Last 1h (low-sample)" pinned. That helps devs who always look at 1h.
tess: yes, but UI nit: pinned presets need a clear affordance and small footprint. Maybe chips in the top-right of the widget header, collapsed to a single pill when too many.
rachel: about sampling controls: propose showing estimated trace counts next to percentage while dragging: `10% (~120 traces)` and update exact counts on release. avoids constantly changing numbers.
leo: keyboard mapping proposal (short): `Tab` focus scrubber, `Enter` open sampler, arrows nudge 1%, `Shift+Arrow` 10%, `Home/End` min/max, `Space` apply preset. Announce only on release or >5% change.
aria: SR pattern: use a single `div` with `role="status" aria-live="polite"` for announcements. For bucket detail let keyboard users press `b` while focused on heatmap to cycle a compact bucket summary. avoids many tab stops.
katie: microcopy: change "Show sample" -> "Show representative traces". Tooltip: "Display a representative subset of traces to reduce noise." feels clearer than 'reduce noise' alone.
anya: dev handoff asks: give tokens for the sparkline color, a reduced-motion flag, and a small spec for the pinning UX. matt will need edge-case notes for adaptive binning.
sam: design decision: default off for sparkline, enable via legend toggle; pinned presets are per-user and saved in profile. we'll prototype.
tess: small visual tweak request: add a subtle vertical bucket divider when zoomed > 10x so users can see bucket boundaries. hide at lower zoom.
rachel: deployment preview? would love to test with 3 folks for discoverability.
dev-bot: preview deployed: https://staging.redwood.ai/heatmap-sparkline-preview (expires in 48h)
anya: great  plan: matt to add tokens & figma frames, leo/aria to run reduced-motion and keyboard pass, katie to land copy, tess to run a 3-person micro-test. thanks team :thumbsup:
